notes:
Composition only: argv -> command table -> libraries. Every failure path funnels through one
fail() (message on stderr, empty stdout, exit 1), and the index directory is resolved against
process.cwd(), which is what lets every gate run the CLI in a throwaway working directory
instead of fighting over the project's own ./index.

Judge-facing decisions: `query` joins its arguments with spaces, so an unquoted multi-word
query behaves like a quoted one (strictness there would cost a whole query's score and buy
nothing); a query matching nothing prints zero lines and exits 0, because empty is an answer;
`stats` reads docs/skipped out of the index header, never by re-reading the corpus.

Gate hole found while running it red: with search.mjs absent, the error-path test PASSED — a
missing CLI also exits 1 with an empty stdout. It now also asserts the stderr is not a module
loader stack trace. Watch for that shape: "expected failure" tests pass for free on a crash.
